title: Uniform Crime Reports [United States]:  Supplementary Homicide Reports, 1976-1983
description:
These Uniform Crime Reports supplementary homicide data 
 provide incident-level information on criminal homicides including 
 information on the date, location, circumstances, and method of 
 offences, as well as demographic characteristics of victims and 
perpetrators and the relationship between the two.
